xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3338: Finished plan agent reads as 'still planning' once its idle signal is cleared

plan.title: Finished plan agent reads as 'still planning' once its idle signal is cleared
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: A plan agent that finalized hours ago with its tmux session still alive renders in simple mode as 'Planning — The agent is breaking this down into tasks' with no Start work button. Root cause chain (all verified in code): (1) complete-planning marks the planning agent stopped via saveAgentStateSync (planning-promotion.ts:566-575) which emits NO agent.status_changed event, so the read model keeps the spawn-time 'running' forever — the DB-says-stopped / read-model-says-live disagreement; (2) the enrichment poller (agent-enrichment-service.ts:221-242 and :196) rewrites stopped-but-tmux-alive agents to 'running' once per server lifetime, entrenching the lie; (3) derivePipelineState (issuePipelineState.ts:65) keys planning_active on that lied-about status; (4) the one correct display path (64e8ce75bc's isPlanReadyToStart) depends on the agentTurnEnded kind which only exists while the runtime snapshot says idle — and boot reconstruction (reconstruct-cache.ts:107-112) derives activity from status, so any dashboard restart permanently clears idle for a finished plan agent that will never fire another Stop hook.
narratives.Proposal: Treat the finalize-time stopped status as the durable turn-end signal and route it into the read model (decision D1; the Stop-hook idle activity stays ephemeral). WI-1: complete-planning emits agent.status_changed(stopped, honest hasLiveTmuxSession) after the gates succeed — moved after the PRD gate so a failed finalize no longer marks the agent stopped prematurely (D4). WI-2: the enrichment poller stops resurrecting interactive-role agents (plan, conv-*) from stopped to running, via an exported pure shouldResurrectStoppedAgent helper sharing the isInteractiveRoleAgent predicate with agent-enrichment.ts (D2, D6); docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md gains the stopped-but-session-alive contract. WI-3: derivePipelineState's awaiting-work gate accepts canonical 'planned' alongside todo/backlog (D5) with a contract comment stating planning_active derives from durable status, never process liveness; deliberately NOT gated on !hasPlan so replanning keeps rendering planning_active (D3). WI-4: simple-mode regression tests lock the no-signal projection: stopped signal-less plan agent + written plan renders needs-you 'The plan is ready' + Start work; running plan agent without a plan renders working.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Making the Stop-hook idle activity durable across restarts/DB rebuilds (event-log folding or sidecar persistence in reconstruct-cache.ts) — unnecessary once status is honest; the conv-* turn-end loss on restart is a separate follow-up issue.
- Changing the stopped→running reconcile for work/review/test/strike roles — standby work agents are a suspected related victim, separate audit.
- Reaping or killing finished planning sessions — skipKill session lifetime is intentional.
- Keying plan-ready on hasPlan regardless of agent status (the issue's option 2) — rejected, mislabels replanning (D3).
- Any change to work.inspect, review convoy, verification gate, or merge machinery.

autoDecisions.summary: Chose the issue's 'durable signal' branch, interpreted as: the finalize-time stopped status IS the durable turn-end record — emit it into the read model and stop the poller from overwriting it — rather than persisting the ephemeral Stop-hook idle activity.
autoDecisions.rationale: Satisfies all three acceptance criteria with no new durable state and no schema change. Persisting idle activity (event-log folding at boot) would not fix the DB/read-model disagreement (AC3), which is caused by the missing finalize event plus the poller flip, and adds machinery the ACs do not require.

autoDecisions.summary: Scoped the flip removal to interactive roles (plan, conv-*) using the existing isInteractiveRole predicate from agent-enrichment.ts:673.
autoDecisions.rationale: For interactive roles, stopped-but-alive is the deliberate post-completion steady state (skipKill finalize; idle conversations). Work/review/test/strike stopped-but-alive is transitional crash recovery where the PAN-1419 reconcile may still be load-bearing; changing it needs its own audit. The issue's AC3 only demands agreement for the stopped-but-session-alive agent in question.

autoDecisions.summary: Did NOT gate planning_active on !hasPlan (the issue's option 2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Replanning runs a plan agent while a spec already exists (deacon-merge.ts:244-248 defers merges while a planning agent runs). Keying plan-ready purely on hasPlan would mislabel an actively replanning agent as ready-to-start — the same class of lie this issue fixes. The durable status fix preserves replanning correctness.

autoDecisions.summary: Moved the complete-planning stop-marking to after the PRD gate and spec promotion.
autoDecisions.rationale: Today it runs before the gates, so a 422 gate failure leaves the agent durably stopped while actually mid-planning. Once the read model honors the stopped status (this fix), that premature stop becomes a user-visible false 'The plan is ready'. Marking stopped only on successful completion is the truthful ordering.

items.title: Emit agent.status_changed(stopped) at successful complete-planning, after the gates

expected_outputs: new tests assert agent.status_changed(stopped, hasLiveTmuxSession:true) appended on skipKill success, no stopped event on PRD-gate 422
existing complete-planning kill/skipKill tests stay green

narrative.Action: In completePlanningForIssue (src/lib/overdeck/planning-promotion.ts), move the stop-marking block (currently lines 566-575) down to just before the existing planning.sync eventStore.append (currently :763-767) so the agent is only marked stopped after the PRD gate and spec promotion succeed. After saveAgentStateSync, compute hasLiveTmuxSession honestly via sessionExists(sessionName) (already imported at :28) and append agent.status_changed with payload { agentId: sessionName, status: 'stopped', previousStatus, hasLiveTmuxSession } through options.eventStore — saveAgentStateSync writes DB + state.json but emits no event, so without this the read model keeps the spawn-time 'running' forever. Keep the whole block in the existing try/catch (non-fatal). Before/after snippet is in the PRD (WI-1). Extend complete-planning.test.ts: (1) skipKill success appends agent.status_changed with status 'stopped' and hasLiveTmuxSession true; (2) session already gone emits hasLiveTmuxSession false; (3) PRD-gate 422 appends no stopped event and leaves the agent running; (4) durable stop write (stoppedAt) still persists on success.

items.title: Given a planning session whose tmux session survives (skipKill), when completePlanningForIssue succeeds, then it appends agent.status_changed carrying status 'stopped' and hasLiveTmuxSession true
When the planning tmux session is already gone at emit time, the appended event carries hasLiveTmuxSession false so the reducer's PAN-1520 wipe applies to dead sessions
When the PRD-first gate rejects the finalize, completePlanningForIssue returns 422, preserves the planning agent's running status, and appends no agent.status_changed stopped event
The durable stop write (saveAgentStateSync with stoppedAt set) still persists to the agents registry on the success path
Enrichment poller honors the durable stopped status for interactive roles + documents the contract

expected_outputs: shouldResurrectStoppedAgent returns false for stopped tmux-live plan and conv- agents, true for stopped tmux-live work agents
both flip sites (reconcile block and agent.created projection) route through shouldResurrectStoppedAgent
typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: Export the interactive-role predicate from src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts as isInteractiveRoleAgent(agentId, role?) (role === 'plan' || agentId.startsWith('conv-')) and rewrite the inline predicate at :673 to use it. In src/dashboard/server/services/agent-enrichment-service.ts add an exported pure helper shouldResurrectStoppedAgent(agentId, role, status, tmuxActive): false unless tmuxActive && status === 'stopped' && !isInteractiveRoleAgent(agentId, role). Route BOTH flip sites through it: the reconcile block at :223 and the agent.created status projection at :196. Update the stale comment above the reconcile block to state interactive roles are exempt because stopped-but-alive is their deliberate steady state. Extraction is required because the existing test file only drives exported pure helpers (pollOnce is private). Add tests to agent-enrichment-service.test.ts per the PRD (plan → false, conv- → false, work → true, non-stopped/not-tmux gates → false, isInteractiveRoleAgent cases). Add a 'Stopped but session-alive' subsection to docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md naming status as the durable record, hasLiveTmuxSession as the liveness signal, and shouldResurrectStoppedAgent in agent-enrichment-service.ts as the single resurrection resolver.

items.title: shouldResurrectStoppedAgent returns false for every stopped tmux-live agent whose role is plan or whose id starts with conv-, and true for a stopped tmux-live work-role agent
Each flip site (the reconcile block and the agent.created projection) routes its stopped-to-running decision through shouldResurrectStoppedAgent
agent-enrichment.ts contains a single exported isInteractiveRoleAgent predicate that its turn-end detection applies at the former inline-predicate site

docs/AGENT-STATE-PLANES.md contains a 'Stopped but session-alive' passage naming hasLiveTmuxSession as the liveness signal and shouldResurrectStoppedAgent in agent-enrichment-service.ts as the resurrection resolver
derivePipelineState awaiting-work gate accepts canonical 'planned' + contract comment + unit tests

expected_outputs: five new derivePipelineState cases pass: planned/backlog/default-open awaiting-work, running-agent planning_active with and without hasPlan, no-plan not-awaiting-work

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/issuePipelineState.ts:65-66, add 'planned' to the canonical states in the planning_done_awaiting_work gate (todo, backlog, planned) and add the contract comment from the PRD: planning_active derives from the plan agent's DURABLE status (finalize flips it to stopped), never from process liveness; a running plan agent is genuinely planning including replanning with an existing spec, so hasPlan must NOT downgrade it (D3). Do not reorder the two checks and do not gate planning_active on !hasPlan. derivePipelineState has no dedicated test file today — create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/__tests__/issue-pipeline-state.test.ts with the five cases from the PRD: (1) stopped plan + hasPlan + 'planned' → planning_done_awaiting_work; (2) stopped plan + hasPlan + 'todo'/'backlog' → planning_done_awaiting_work; (3) running plan + hasPlan + 'todo' → planning_active; (4) running plan + no plan → planning_active; (5) stopped plan + no plan + 'todo' → not planning_done_awaiting_work.

items.title: derivePipelineState returns planning_done_awaiting_work for a stopped plan agent with hasPlan and canonical state planned, backlog, or the default open state
derivePipelineState returns planning_active for a running plan agent whether or not hasPlan is true
The new issue-pipeline-state.test.ts passes all five derivePipelineState cases under the frontend Vitest project

expected_outputs: stopped signal-less plan agent + hasPlan renders needs-you / 'The plan is ready' / 'Start work' and buckets into simple-home needs-you as start-work
running plan agent without a plan renders working / 'Planning'; running plan agent with a plan (replan) renders working

narrative.Action: Extend src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/__tests__/simple-derive.test.ts (match the fixture style commit 64e8ce75bc added) with characterization tests locking this issue's acceptance criteria at the simple-mode layer: (1) stopped plan-role agent, hasPlan true, pendingInputKinds [], canonical todo → display.state 'needs-you', needsYouReason 'start-work', primaryAction 'Start work', title 'The plan is ready'; (2) same fixture → bucketSimpleHome places the issue in needsYou with kind 'start-work'; (3) running plan-role agent, hasPlan false, no kinds → display.state 'working', title 'Planning'; (4) running plan-role agent, hasPlan true, no kinds (replan in flight) → display.state 'working'. These pass once the agent status is honest (items finalize-status-event and poller-stops-resurrecting-interactive-agents make it honest upstream); they exist so a regression in any of the three layers fails here.

items.title: A stopped, signal-less plan agent with a written plan renders needs-you / 'The plan is ready' / 'Start work' and buckets into simple-home needs-you as start-work
A running plan agent without a written plan renders working / 'Planning'
